about: Endorsement slates and candidate alliances for NYC ranked-choice primaries. Reviewed by hand; add_slates.py copies them into ballots/<contest>.json as the `slates` field. Members are candidate names as the source wrote them; `aliases` maps a source spelling to the exact name in the metadata. When `ordered` is true, members are listed in the order the source asked voters to rank them. See README.md, section Slates.

slates.name: Yang and Garcia
slates.note: Joint campaigning the weekend before the June 22 primary. Yang asked his voters to rank Garcia second; Garcia campaigned with him but said she was not co-endorsing.

slates.note: Cross-endorsed and asked voters to rank both.

slates.note: Stringer 1, Morales 2, Wiley 3. Replaced by the June 4 ranking; kept because it was the party's published slate for six weeks.

slates.name: Working Families Party
